name: Feedback pins
description: Comment anywhere on a page or component: pins, threads, @mentions, reactions, unread markers and export, for people and their coding agents. Kept in the project, so feedback commits and pulls with the site.

permissions.label: Leave and reply to comments
permissions.description: Without it the role sees threads and pins, view only.

permissions.label: Resolve threads
permissions.description: Mark a thread resolved, or reopen it.

permissions.label: Delete anyone's comments
permissions.description: Without it, people delete only their own comments and threads.
